name: com.ezg.cheat-gate
description: Opens in-game cheats on release builds only for listed test phones. Tapping the version label 10 times asks the EZG cheat-gate Worker once whether this phone (hashed SystemInfo.deviceUniqueIdentifier, shown as XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) is on the project's list; a listed phone gets an RSA-signed grant (bound to the request's nonce) valid 7 days offline, re-checked at launch and on return to the foreground (at most every 30 minutes) only by phones that hold one. Ordinary players never send a request. The list is managed with the ezg MCP tools test_device_add / test_device_remove (BugHub Lead / QA).
